_profile_preference_note: Order in which the FROZEN accelerator profiles are tried. Both are covered by the rental authorization, so reordering adds no capability — it only expresses which part the operator wants FIRST. Set ["B200","B300"] to prefer the B200 (e.g. when B300 demand makes it unobtainable); the session still falls back to the other profile and records the reason. Unknown profile names are refused.
